summary.name: Photorealism (name_en). Explicit provenance, category Digital and 3D Aesthetics. The source says a photoreal look does not establish that footage was filmed.
summary.visualIdentity: Photoreal 3D rendering with credible scale, roughness, contact shadows, reflections, lighting and restrained depth of field. Objects need weight and consistent contact, camera moves stay measured, and the subject stays readable without unexplained highlights, floating geometry, intersections or excessive blur.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit: product hero shots and material studies where plausible light and contact carry the message, and hybrids where thin overlays explain dimensions or internals. Inferred: launch films and premium product pages for physical goods. Subject, audience and duration are unspecified.
summary.limitations: The browser preview is a bounded Three.js PBR approximation and cannot provide traced caustics. The full-quality Blender, Cycles and baked-simulation route is unavailable and must be reported as missing. The sweep backdrop is one-sided and needs extension for orbits. Caustic recipes are approximations only.
summary.palette: Background is scene_dependent: derive it from the subject, environment, lighting and mood, not a default. Example tokens #F0EDE5 background, #2B302F foreground and #827D6D accent are authored suggestions, not approved exact colors. Foreground on background is 11.458; accent on background at 3.517 is decorative only. Gradients are disabled. Source reviews show a quiet background, a materially lit hero and one rare emissive accent.
summary.motionAndInteraction: The 3s preview uses a GSAP-owned measured dolly or arc with a slow 10° arc, focus pull and an eased object settle without floating. motion-043 360° orbit suits a stationary PBR hero with finished surroundings; only the camera moves and the end frame matches the start. Pointer or scroll input is for interactive delivery only; video uses absolute time.
summary.audio: The style does not specify audio. Audio direction is suggestion-based: propose a coherent direction and state assumptions, with no fixed soundtrack. For orbits, consider ambience or a restrained swell with at most one accent at settle, and avoid whooshes on every quarter turn. Previews are silent. No measured beat or speech data is supplied.
summary.assetRequirements: No uploaded assets are named. A PBR hero with finished geometry on every side is needed for orbits, along with a complete environment and a lighting setup. Captured turntables need enough views. Flat, depth-map or 2.5D art cannot support a full orbit and needs a labelled partial-arc adaptation or another motion. Full-quality output needs Blender with Cycles.
summary.combinations: Photorealism alone suits material studies and product heroes. style-097 adds measured callouts and cutaway overlays, revealed only during camera holds in #2B302F and #827D6D. style-096 adds restrained product pacing, one camera move per shot and single sans-serif type in #2B302F. Avoid floating labels, glow or heavy blur.
summary.productionApproach: Visual construction uses Three.js with PBR materials, a PMREM environment, PCF soft shadows, ACES tone mapping, restrained BokehPass depth of field and OutputPass. GSAP is the motion engine with one owner per property. HyperFrames is the default pipeline for assembly, check, snapshot and render; Remotion only with a recorded reason. chroma.js is optional for contrast checks.
